PHASE 01

A little unsure.

The first brave moment.

New space. New sounds. Paws planted firmly on the belt. Some pups hesitate before taking a step. We give them time to get comfortable.

✳ A calm introduction
PHASE 02

One paw at a time.

Small steps. Big courage.

A little confidence arrives. They begin stepping forward, concentrating on where each paw lands. Every little step is a win.

✳ Focus & coordination
PHASE 03

Finding their rhythm.

Look who’s got this.

Those careful steps become a steady pattern. Your dog finds a comfortable rhythm and keeps the belt moving under their own power.

✳ A consistent rhythm
PHASE 04

Let’s try a little more.

Their pace. Their choice.

Speed up. Slow down. Stop. Start again. With a rhythm established, they explore how their movement changes the belt’s speed.

✳ Choice & confidence
PHASE 05

Free reign. Full joy.

That’s one happy runner.

They know the ropes and move with confidence, exploring what they can do. Their coach stays close, with breaks and a pace that suits the dog.

FIRST RUN? WE’VE GOT YOU.

A few good
questions.

Still curious? Let’s talk about your pup.

My dog has never used a treadmill. Is that okay?

Learning something new takes a little practice. Dogs settle in at different speeds; the team typically sees them learn over 1–3 sessions. Your coach will help them get comfortable.

Does the treadmill control my dog’s speed?

No. The treadmills are powered entirely by your dog’s movement, without an electric motor. Your pup decides how fast or slow to go.

How do I get my dog ready?

Give them a bathroom break, avoid food for at least one hour before the run, and put on their harness if they have one.

Can I stay with my dog?

Yes. You’re welcome to join your pup in the climate-controlled van during the session.

What if I need to reschedule?

Use the rescheduling link in your appointment confirmation email. Please make changes at least four hours before your appointment.
